scripts.preview: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=cosbuilt-website
scripts.db:migrate:local: wrangler d1 execute cosbuilt-db --local --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute cosbuilt-db --local --file=migrations/0002_seed.sql
scripts.db:migrate:remote: wrangler d1 execute cosbuilt-db --remote --file=migrations/0001_init.sql && wrangler d1 execute cosbuilt-db --remote --file=migrations/0002_seed.sql
